title: Patient Rights Figures by Medical Records Requests Type
content:
Three patient rights attached to Medical Records Requests carry per-type figures: asking to amend the released record, obtaining free accountings of disclosures, and having a denial on a reviewable ground reviewed by another licensed professional.

| Request type | Amendment of the released record may be requested through this type | Days to act on an amendment request (calendar days) | Free accountings of disclosures per patient in a rolling 12 months | Review of a reviewable denial available | Days to complete a denial review (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal Self-Service Download | Yes | 60 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Patient Electronic Copy Request | Yes | 60 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Patient Paper Copy Request | Yes | 60 | 1 | Yes | 30 |
| Provider-to-Provider Transfer | No | 0 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Third-Party Authorized Release | No | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 |
| Certified Legal Records Package | No | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 |
| Imaging Disc Copy Request | No | 0 | 0 | Yes | 30 |

## Reading the table

- Amendment requests and free accountings of disclosures are offered through the three patient-copy types — the Portal Self-Service Download, the Patient Electronic Copy Request and the Patient Paper Copy Request — each with a 60-day period to act on an amendment and one free accounting in a rolling 12 months.
- Denial review is available on every type except the Provider-to-Provider Transfer, and where available it is completed within 30 calendar days.
